blockers: The face reads as a pale rectangular mask with detached cyan eye marks and an isolated red mouth. Hair is a single cap-like volume, and the head lacks readable brow, nose, jaw, or collar integration. This is a mannequin/uncanny failure at native 1x.
The canonical idle strip is effectively static. The small changes do not communicate breath, balance, tension, or a deliberate settled stance, so Celina has no convincing living presence.

The locomotion cycles lack a clear support leg and planted contact phase. Legs repeatedly form scissor-like extremes while the pelvis and torso remain locked, producing a sliding mannequin walk rather than controlled weight transfer.

The rapier gesture is primarily a blade sweep. The arm, shoulder, torso, and hips barely participate, so the signature action reads as a prop moving independently instead of a deliberate duelist drawing, presenting, and settling the weapon.

The front silhouette is generic and internally congested. Shoulder protrusions, forearms, corset, sword hand, and scabbard do not separate cleanly in the mask; the intended high collar and corset are not identifiable shapes at 1x.
Secondary motion is absent. Hair, collar, shoulder ornaments, scabbard, and costume masses show no controlled lag or follow-through to support Celina's restrained personality.
The rapier is frequently a one-pixel line that loses a clean hand-to-hilt relationship in profile and diagonal views, while also merging with the legs or background in several frames.
high_value_changes: Redesign the head as a native-1x pixel-readable construction: establish a distinct hair silhouette, deliberate brow and eye grouping, a minimal but intentional nose/mouth cluster, and a visible high-collar connection. Do not merely downsample a smooth 3D face.

Rebuild all walk cycles from contact, down, passing, up, and recovery poses. Hold a visibly flat supporting foot, roll through the step, shift the pelvis over the support leg, counter-rotate the shoulders, and keep the rapier hand mechanically attached to the weapon.

Replace the current idle with a restrained balance loop: a measurable ribcage breath, slight hip settle, opposing shoulder response, and tiny sword or scabbard compensation. The motion must survive native 1x viewing.
Re-author the signature gesture around a complete body action: anticipation in the torso and free arm, committed rapier draw or presentation, a controlled overshoot, then a visible guarded settle.

Clarify the costume silhouette and material hierarchy. Make the collar, corset waist, shoulder structure, brass fittings, sword hilt, and scabbard read as designed masses rather than tiny colored flecks.
Audit every direction at native 1x, prioritizing N, S, and diagonal views where the legs, blade, and hands collapse into ambiguous vertical or crossing marks.

luna_evaluation.single_most_important_next_change: Replace the current mannequin-like head with a deliberately authored native-1x face, hair mass, and collar silhouette; validate that redesign across all eight directions before adding further animation polish.
